1→"""Typed contracts and schema helpers for review import payloads."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     6→from typing import Any, NotRequired, Required, TypedDict
     7→
     8→REVIEW_FINDING_REQUIRED_FIELDS = (
     9→    "dimension",
    10→    "identifier",
    11→    "summary",
    12→    "confidence",
    13→    "suggestion",
    14→    "related_files",
    15→    "evidence",
    16→)
    17→VALID_REVIEW_CONFIDENCE = frozenset({"high", "medium", "low"})
    18→
    19→
    20→class ReviewFindingPayload(TypedDict, total=False):
    21→    """Single finding entry in review import payloads."""
    22→
    23→    file: str
    24→    dimension: str
    25→    identifier: str
    26→    summary: str
    27→    confidence: str
    28→    suggestion: str
    29→    evidence: list[str]
    30→    related_files: list[str]
    31→    reasoning: str
    32→    evidence_lines: list[int]
    33→    concern_verdict: str
    34→    concern_fingerprint: str
    35→    concern_type: str
    36→    concern_file: str
    37→
    38→
    39→def _normalized_non_empty_text(value: object) -> str | None:
    40→    if not isinstance(value, str):
    41→        return None
    42→    text = value.strip()
    43→    return text if text else None
    44→
    45→
    46→def _normalized_non_empty_text_list(value: object) -> list[str] | None:
    47→    if not isinstance(value, list):
    48→        return None
    49→    cleaned = [
    50→        str(item).strip()
    51→        for item in value
    52→        if isinstance(item, str) and item.strip()
    53→    ]
    54→    return cleaned if cleaned else None
    55→
    56→
    57→def _append_optional_text_fields(
    58→    payload: ReviewFindingPayload,
    59→    finding: dict[str, Any],
    60→    *,
    61→    fields: tuple[str, ...],
    62→) -> None:
    63→    """Copy optional non-empty text fields onto normalized payload."""
    64→    for field_name in fields:
    65→        normalized = _normalized_non_empty_text(finding.get(field_name))
    66→        if normalized is not None:
    67→            payload[field_name] = normalized
    68→
    69→
    70→def _validate_dismissed_review_finding(
    71→    finding: dict[str, Any],
    72→    *,
    73→    label: str,
    74→    allow_dismissed: bool,
    75→) -> tuple[ReviewFindingPayload | None, list[str]] | None:
    76→    """Validate dismissed finding path; return None when not a dismissed finding."""
    77→    if finding.get("concern_verdict") != "dismissed":
    78→        return None
    79→    if not allow_dismissed:
    80→        return None, [f"{label}.concern_verdict='dismissed' is not allowed here"]
    81→
    82→    fingerprint = _normalized_non_empty_text(finding.get("concern_fingerprint"))
    83→    if fingerprint is None:
    84→        return (
    85→            None,
    86→            [f"{label}.concern_fingerprint is required when concern_verdict='dismissed'"],
    87→        )
    88→    normalized: ReviewFindingPayload = {
    89→        "concern_verdict": "dismissed",
    90→        "concern_fingerprint": fingerprint,
    91→    }
    92→    _append_optional_text_fields(
    93→        normalized,
    94→        finding,
    95→        fields=("concern_type", "concern_file", "reasoning"),
    96→    )
    97→    return normalized, []
    98→
    99→
   100→def _missing_required_fields(finding: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
   101→    """List missing required review finding fields."""
   102→    return [field for field in REVIEW_FINDING_REQUIRED_FIELDS if field not in finding]
   103→
   104→
   105→def _validate_primary_dimension(
   106→    finding: dict[str, Any],
   107→    *,
   108→    label: str,
   109→    allowed_dimensions: set[str] | None,
   110→    errors: list[str],
   111→) -> str | None:
   112→    """Validate and return normalized finding dimension."""
   113→    dimension = _normalized_non_empty_text(finding.get("dimension"))
   114→    if dimension is None:
   115→        errors.append(f"{label}.dimension must be a non-empty string")
   116→    elif allowed_dimensions is not None and dimension not in allowed_dimensions:
   117→        errors.append(f"{label}.dimension '{dimension}' is not allowed")
   118→    return dimension
   119→
   120→
   121→def _validate_confidence_text(
   122→    finding: dict[str, Any], *, label: str, errors: list[str]
   123→) -> str:
   124→    """Validate confidence label and return normalized text."""
   125→    confidence = _normalized_non_empty_text(finding.get("confidence"))
   126→    confidence_text = confidence.lower() if confidence is not None else ""
   127→    if confidence_text not in VALID_REVIEW_CONFIDENCE:
   128→        errors.append(f"{label}.confidence must be one of: high, medium, low")
   129→    return confidence_text
   130→
   131→
   132→def _required_text_field(
   133→    finding: dict[str, Any], *, field_name: str, label: str, errors: list[str]
   134→) -> str | None:
   135→    """Validate required non-empty string field."""
   136→    value = _normalized_non_empty_text(finding.get(field_name))
   137→    if value is None:
   138→        errors.append(f"{label}.{field_name} must be a non-empty string")
   139→    return value
   140→
   141→
   142→def _required_text_list_field(
   143→    finding: dict[str, Any],
   144→    *,
   145→    field_name: str,
   146→    label: str,
   147→    errors: list[str],
   148→    error_message: str,
   149→) -> list[str] | None:
   150→    """Validate required non-empty list[str] field."""
   151→    value = _normalized_non_empty_text_list(finding.get(field_name))
   152→    if value is None:
   153→        errors.append(error_message)
   154→    return value
   155→
   156→
   157→def _validate_standard_review_finding(
   158→    finding: dict[str, Any],
   159→    *,
   160→    label: str,
   161→    allowed_dimensions: set[str] | None,
   162→) -> tuple[ReviewFindingPayload | None, list[str]]:
   163→    """Validate non-dismissed finding path."""
   164→    errors: list[str] = []
   165→    missing = _missing_required_fields(finding)
   166→    if missing:
   167→        errors.append(f"{label} missing required fields: {', '.join(missing)}")
   168→        return None, errors
   169→
   170→    dimension = _validate_primary_dimension(
   171→        finding, label=label, allowed_dimensions=allowed_dimensions, errors=errors
   172→    )
   173→    identifier = _required_text_field(
   174→        finding, field_name="identifier", label=label, errors=errors
   175→    )
   176→    summary = _required_text_field(
   177→        finding, field_name="summary", label=label, errors=errors
   178→    )
   179→    suggestion = _required_text_field(
   180→        finding, field_name="suggestion", label=label, errors=errors
   181→    )
   182→    confidence_text = _validate_confidence_text(finding, label=label, errors=errors)
   183→    related_files = _required_text_list_field(
   184→        finding,
   185→        field_name="related_files",
   186→        label=label,
   187→        errors=errors,
   188→        error_message=f"{label}.related_files must contain at least one file path string",
   189→    )
   190→    evidence = _required_text_list_field(
   191→        finding,
   192→        field_name="evidence",
   193→        label=label,
   194→        errors=errors,
   195→        error_message=f"{label}.evidence must contain at least one concrete evidence string",
   196→    )
   197→
   198→    if errors:
   199→        return None, errors
   200→    return (
   201→        {
   202→            "dimension": dimension or "",
   203→            "identifier": identifier or "",
   204→            "summary": summary or "",
   205→            "confidence": confidence_text,
   206→            "suggestion": suggestion or "",
   207→            "related_files": related_files or [],
   208→            "evidence": evidence or [],
   209→        },
   210→        [],
   211→    )
   212→
   213→
   214→def validate_review_finding_payload(
   215→    finding: object,
   216→    *,
   217→    label: str,
   218→    allowed_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
   219→    allow_dismissed: bool = True,
   220→) -> tuple[ReviewFindingPayload | None, list[str]]:
   221→    """Validate and normalize one review finding payload entry."""
   222→    if not isinstance(finding, dict):
   223→        return None, [f"{label} must be an object"]
   224→
   225→    dismissed_result = _validate_dismissed_review_finding(
   226→        finding, label=label, allow_dismissed=allow_dismissed
   227→    )
   228→    if dismissed_result is not None:
   229→        return dismissed_result
   230→
   231→    normalized_payload, errors = _validate_standard_review_finding(
   232→        finding, label=label, allowed_dimensions=allowed_dimensions
   233→    )
   234→    if normalized_payload is None:
   235→        return None, errors
   236→
   237→    _append_optional_text_fields(
   238→        normalized_payload,
   239→        finding,
   240→        fields=("reasoning", "concern_type", "concern_file"),
   241→    )
   242→    file_path = _normalized_non_empty_text(finding.get("file"))
   243→    if file_path is not None:
   244→        normalized_payload["file"] = file_path
   245→    evidence_lines = finding.get("evidence_lines")
   246→    if isinstance(evidence_lines, list):
   247→        normalized_lines = [line for line in evidence_lines if isinstance(line, int)]
   248→        if normalized_lines:
   249→            normalized_payload["evidence_lines"] = normalized_lines
   250→    return normalized_payload, []
   251→

   362→    ) -> AssessmentImportPolicyModel:

   368→            trusted=bool(data.get("trusted", False)),

   370→            reason=str(data.get("reason", "") or ""),
   371→            provenance=AssessmentProvenanceModel.from_mapping(data.get("provenance")),
   372→            attest=(str(attest).strip() if isinstance(attest, str) and attest.strip() else None),
   373→        )

   116→def _build_imported_finding(

   121→    dimension = finding["dimension"]

   123→    is_confirmed_concern = finding.get("concern_verdict") == "confirmed"
   124→    detector = "concerns" if is_confirmed_concern else "review"
   125→    content_hash = hashlib.sha256(summary_text.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
   126→    detail: dict[str, Any] = {

   132→        "reasoning": finding.get("reasoning", ""),
   133→    }
   134→    if is_confirmed_concern:

   136→        detail["concern_verdict"] = "confirmed"

   138→    prefix = "concern" if is_confirmed_concern else "holistic"
   139→    file = finding.get("concern_file", "") if is_confirmed_concern else ""
   140→    confidence = normalize_review_confidence(finding.get("confidence", "low"))
   141→    imported = make_finding(

   145→        tier=review_tier(confidence, holistic=True),
   146→        confidence=confidence,

   154→def _validate_and_build_findings(
   155→    findings_list: list[ReviewFindingPayload],
   156→    holistic_prompts: dict[str, Any],
   157→    lang_name: str,
   158→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
   159→    """Validate raw holistic findings and build state-ready finding dicts.
   160→
   161→    Returns (review_findings, skipped, dismissed_concerns).
   162→    """
   163→    review_findings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   164→    skipped: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   165→    dismissed_concerns: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   166→    allowed_dimensions = {
   167→        dim for dim in holistic_prompts if isinstance(dim, str) and dim.strip()
   168→    }
   169→
   170→    for idx, raw_finding in enumerate(findings_list):
   171→        finding, finding_errors = validate_review_finding_payload(
   172→            raw_finding,
   173→            label=f"findings[{idx}]",
   174→            allowed_dimensions=allowed_dimensions,
   175→            allow_dismissed=True,
   176→        )
   177→        if finding_errors:
   178→            _append_skipped(
   179→                skipped,
   180→                index=idx,
   181→                missing=finding_errors,
   182→                identifier=_finding_identifier(raw_finding),
   183→            )
   184→            continue
   185→        if finding is None:
   186→            _append_skipped(
   187→                skipped,
   188→                index=idx,
   189→                missing=["normalized finding payload missing"],
   190→                identifier=_finding_identifier(raw_finding),
   191→            )
   192→            continue
   193→
   194→        if finding.get("concern_verdict") == "dismissed":
   195→            dismissed = _dismissed_concern_payload(finding)
   196→            if dismissed is not None:
   197→                dismissed_concerns.append(dismissed)
   198→            continue
   199→
   200→        summary_text = str(finding.get("summary", ""))
   201→        if _is_positive_observation(summary_text):
   202→            _append_skipped(
   203→                skipped,
   204→                index=idx,
   205→                missing=["positive observation (not a defect)"],
   206→                identifier=str(finding.get("identifier", "<none>")),
   207→            )
   208→            continue
   209→
   210→        review_findings.append(_build_imported_finding(finding, lang_name=lang_name))
   211→
   212→    return review_findings, skipped, dismissed_concerns

   273→def _collect_imported_dimensions(
   274→    *,

   295→def _auto_resolve_stale_holistic(
   296→    state: dict[str, Any],
   297→    new_ids: set[str],
   298→    diff: dict[str, Any],
   299→    utc_now_fn,
   300→    *,
   301→    imported_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
   302→    full_sweep_included: bool | None = None,
   303→) -> None:
   304→    """Auto-resolve open holistic findings not present in the latest import."""
   305→    scope_dimensions = {
   306→        normalize_dimension_name(dim)
   307→        for dim in (imported_dimensions or set())
   308→        if isinstance(dim, str) and dim.strip()
   309→    }
   310→    scoped_reimport = full_sweep_included is False
   311→    # Partial re-import with unknown dimension scope: do not auto-resolve.
   312→    if scoped_reimport and not scope_dimensions:
   313→        return
   314→
   315→    def _should_resolve(finding: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
   316→        if finding.get("detector") not in ("review", "concerns"):
   317→            return False
   318→        detail = finding.get("detail")
   319→        if not isinstance(detail, dict) or not detail.get("holistic"):
   320→            return False
   321→        if not scoped_reimport:
   322→            return True
   323→        dimension = normalize_dimension_name(str(detail.get("dimension", "")))
   324→        return dimension in scope_dimensions
   325→
   326→    auto_resolve_review_findings(
   327→        state,
   328→        new_ids=new_ids,
   329→        diff=diff,
   330→        note="not reported in latest holistic re-import",
   331→        should_resolve=_should_resolve,
   332→        utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   333→    )
   334→

   336→def import_holistic_findings(
   337→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   338→    state: dict[str, Any],
   339→    lang_name: str,
   340→    *,
   341→    project_root: Path | str | None = None,
   342→    utc_now_fn=utc_now,
   343→) -> dict[str, Any]:
   344→    """Import holistic (codebase-wide) findings into state."""
   345→    payload: ReviewImportEnvelope = parse_review_import_payload(
   346→        findings_data,
   347→        mode_name="Holistic",
   348→    )
   349→    findings_list = payload.findings
   350→    assessments = payload.assessments
   351→    reviewed_files = payload.reviewed_files
   352→    review_scope = _normalize_review_scope_payload(findings_data.get("review_scope", {}))
   353→    scope_full_sweep = review_scope["full_sweep_included"]
   354→    if not isinstance(scope_full_sweep, bool):
   355→        scope_full_sweep = None
   356→    if assessments:
   357→        store_assessments(
   358→            state,
   359→            assessments,
   360→            source="holistic",
   361→            utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   362→        )
   363→
   364→    _, holistic_prompts, _ = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang_name)
   365→    valid_dimensions = {
   366→        normalize_dimension_name(dim)
   367→        for dim in holistic_prompts
   368→        if isinstance(dim, str)
   369→    }
   370→    review_findings, skipped, dismissed_concerns = _validate_and_build_findings(
   371→        findings_list, holistic_prompts, lang_name
   372→    )
   373→    imported_dimensions = _collect_imported_dimensions(
   374→        findings_list=findings_list,
   375→        review_findings=review_findings,
   376→        assessments=assessments if isinstance(assessments, dict) else None,
   377→        review_scope=review_scope,
   378→        valid_dimensions=valid_dimensions,
   379→    )
   380→
   381→    # Store dismissed concern verdicts for suppression in future concern generation.
   382→    if dismissed_concerns:
   383→        store = state.setdefault("concern_dismissals", {})
   384→        now = utc_now_fn()
   385→        # Compute current concerns to get source_finding_ids for each fingerprint.
   386→        current_concerns = generate_concerns(state, lang_name=lang_name)
   387→        concern_sources = {
   388→            c.fingerprint: list(c.source_findings) for c in current_concerns
   389→        }
   390→        for dc in dismissed_concerns:
   391→            fp = dc["fingerprint"]
   392→            store[fp] = {
   393→                "dismissed_at": now,
   394→                "reasoning": dc.get("reasoning", ""),
   395→                "concern_type": dc.get("concern_type", ""),
   396→                "concern_file": dc.get("concern_file", ""),
   397→                "source_finding_ids": concern_sources.get(fp, []),
   398→            }
   399→
   400→    potentials = _lang_potentials(state, lang_name)
   401→    existing_review = potentials.get("review", 0)
   402→    potentials["review"] = max(existing_review, HOLISTIC_POTENTIAL)
   403→
   404→    concern_count = sum(1 for f in review_findings if f.get("detector") == "concerns")
   405→    if concern_count:
   406→        potentials["concerns"] = max(potentials.get("concerns", 0), concern_count)
   407→
   408→    merge_potentials_dict: dict[str, int] = {"review": potentials.get("review", 0)}
   409→    if potentials.get("concerns", 0) > 0:
   410→        merge_potentials_dict["concerns"] = potentials["concerns"]
   411→
   412→    diff = merge_scan(
   413→        state,
   414→        review_findings,
   415→        options=MergeScanOptions(
   416→            lang=lang_name,
   417→            potentials=merge_potentials_dict,
   418→            merge_potentials=True,
   419→        ),
   420→    )
   421→
   422→    new_ids = {finding["id"] for finding in review_findings}
   423→    _auto_resolve_stale_holistic(
   424→        state,
   425→        new_ids,
   426→        diff,
   427→        utc_now_fn,
   428→        imported_dimensions=imported_dimensions,
   429→        full_sweep_included=scope_full_sweep,
   430→    )
   431→
   432→    if skipped:
   433→        diff["skipped"] = len(skipped)
   434→        diff["skipped_details"] = skipped
   435→
   436→    update_reviewed_file_cache(
   437→        state,
   438→        reviewed_files,
   439→        project_root=project_root,
   440→        utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   441→    )
   442→    resolve_reviewed_file_coverage_findings(
   443→        state,
   444→        diff,
   445→        reviewed_files,
   446→        utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   447→    )
   448→    update_holistic_review_cache(
   449→        state,
   450→        findings_list,
   451→        lang_name=lang_name,
   452→        review_scope=review_scope,
   453→        utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   454→    )
   455→    resolve_holistic_coverage_findings(state, diff, utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn)
   456→
   457→    # Clean up dismissals whose source findings were all resolved — runs after
   458→    # all finding mutations (merge_scan, auto_resolve, coverage resolve) so it
   459→    # sees the final state.
   460→    cleanup_stale_dismissals(state)
   461→
   462→    return diff
   463→
   464→
   465→def _resolve_total_files(state: dict[str, Any], lang_name: str | None) -> int:
   466→    """Best-effort total file count from codebase_metrics or review cache."""
   467→    review_cache = state.get("review_cache", {})
   468→    fallback = len(review_cache.get("files", {}))
   469→
   470→    codebase_metrics = state.get("codebase_metrics", {})
   471→    if not isinstance(codebase_metrics, dict):
   472→        return fallback
   473→
   474→    # Try language-specific metrics first, then global.
   475→    sources = []
   476→    if lang_name:
   477→        lang_metrics = codebase_metrics.get(lang_name)
   478→        if isinstance(lang_metrics, dict):
   479→            sources.append(lang_metrics)
   480→    sources.append(codebase_metrics)
   481→
   482→    for source in sources:
   483→        metric_total = source.get("total_files")
   484→        if isinstance(metric_total, int) and metric_total > 0:
   485→            return metric_total
   486→
   487→    return fallback
   488→
   489→
   490→def update_holistic_review_cache(
   491→    state: dict[str, Any],
   492→    findings_data: list[dict],
   493→    *,
   494→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   495→    review_scope: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
   496→    utc_now_fn=utc_now,
   497→) -> None:
   498→    """Store holistic review metadata in review_cache."""
   499→    review_cache = state.setdefault("review_cache", {})
   500→    now = utc_now_fn()
   501→    _, holistic_prompts, _ = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang_name or "")
   502→
   503→    valid = [
   504→        finding
   505→        for finding in findings_data
   506→        if all(
   507→            key in finding
   508→            for key in ("dimension", "identifier", "summary", "confidence")
   509→        )
   510→        and finding["dimension"] in holistic_prompts
   511→    ]
   512→
   513→    resolved_total_files: int
   514→    review_scope_payload = _normalize_review_scope_payload(review_scope)
   515→    total_override = review_scope_payload["total_files"]
   516→    if (
   517→        isinstance(total_override, int)
   518→        and not isinstance(total_override, bool)
   519→        and total_override > 0
   520→    ):
   521→        resolved_total_files = total_override
   522→    else:
   523→        resolved_total_files = _resolve_total_files(state, lang_name)
   524→
   525→    holistic_entry: dict[str, Any] = {
   526→        "reviewed_at": now,
   527→        "file_count_at_review": resolved_total_files,
   528→        "finding_count": len(valid),
   529→    }
   530→    reviewed_files_count = review_scope_payload["reviewed_files_count"]
   531→    if (
   532→        isinstance(reviewed_files_count, int)
   533→        and not isinstance(reviewed_files_count, bool)
   534→        and reviewed_files_count >= 0
   535→    ):
   536→        holistic_entry["reviewed_files_count"] = reviewed_files_count
   537→    full_sweep_included = review_scope_payload["full_sweep_included"]
   538→    if isinstance(full_sweep_included, bool):
   539→        holistic_entry["full_sweep_included"] = full_sweep_included
   540→
   541→    review_cache["holistic"] = holistic_entry
   542→
   543→
   544→def resolve_holistic_coverage_findings(
   545→    state: dict[str, Any],
   546→    diff: dict[str, Any],
   547→    *,
   548→    utc_now_fn=utc_now,
   549→) -> None:
   550→    """Resolve stale holistic coverage entries after successful holistic import."""
   551→    now = utc_now_fn()
   552→    for finding in state.get("findings", {}).values():
   553→        if finding.get("status") != "open":
   554→            continue
   555→        if finding.get("detector") != "subjective_review":
   556→            continue
   557→
   558→        finding_id = finding.get("id", "")
   559→        if (
   560→            "::holistic_unreviewed" not in finding_id
   561→            and "::holistic_stale" not in finding_id
   562→        ):
   563→            continue
   564→
   565→        finding["status"] = "auto_resolved"
   566→        finding["resolved_at"] = now
   567→        finding["note"] = "resolved by holistic review import"
   568→        finding["resolution_attestation"] = {
   569→            "kind": "agent_import",
   570→            "text": "Holistic review refreshed; coverage marker superseded",
   571→            "attested_at": now,
   572→            "scan_verified": False,
   573→        }
   574→        diff["auto_resolved"] += 1
   575→
   576→
   577→def resolve_reviewed_file_coverage_findings(
   578→    state: dict[str, Any],

   584→    """Resolve per-file subjective coverage markers for freshly reviewed files."""
   585→    if not reviewed_files:

   587→
   588→    reviewed_set = {path for path in reviewed_files if isinstance(path, str) and path}
   589→    if not reviewed_set:

   602→
   603→        finding_file = finding.get("file", "")
   604→        if finding_file not in reviewed_set:

   606→
   607→        finding["status"] = "auto_resolved"

   610→        finding["resolution_attestation"] = {

   171→

   177→    if not isinstance(findings, list):

   179→    for idx, finding in enumerate(findings):

   189→        )

   234→        finding_count = count if isinstance(count, int) else 0
   235→    file_cache[file_path] = {

   260→            for file_path in reviewed_files
   261→            if isinstance(file_path, str) and str(file_path).strip()
   262→        )

   264→    for file_path in reviewed_set:
   265→        upsert_review_cache_entry(

   267→            file_path,
   268→            project_root=resolved_project_root,
   269→            hash_file_fn=hash_file_fn,
   270→            utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   271→            finding_count=counts.get(file_path),

   275→def auto_resolve_review_findings(
   276→    state: dict[str, Any],
   277→    *,
   278→    new_ids: set[str],
   279→    diff: dict[str, Any],
   280→    note: str,
   281→    should_resolve: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], bool],
   282→    utc_now_fn=utc_now,
   283→) -> None:
   284→    """Auto-resolve stale open review findings that match a scope predicate."""
   285→    diff.setdefault("auto_resolved", 0)
   286→    for finding_id, finding in require_findings(state).items():
   287→        if finding_id in new_ids or finding.get("status") != "open":
   288→            continue
   289→        if not should_resolve(finding):
   290→            continue
   291→        finding["status"] = "auto_resolved"
   292→        finding["resolved_at"] = utc_now_fn()
   293→        finding["note"] = note
   294→        diff["auto_resolved"] += 1

   133→        str(finding["file"])
   134→        for finding in findings_list
   135→        if all(key in finding for key in required_fields)
   136→    }
   137→    valid_reviewed_files_abs = {
   138→        _absolutize_review_path(str(finding["file"]), project_root=resolved_project_root)
   139→        for finding in findings_list
   140→        if all(key in finding for key in required_fields)
   141→    }
   142→    valid_reviewed_files = valid_reviewed_files_rel | valid_reviewed_files_abs
   143→    reviewed_files_rel = {
   144→        str(file_path).strip()
   145→        for file_path in reviewed_files
   146→        if isinstance(file_path, str) and file_path.strip()
   147→    }
   148→    reviewed_files_abs = {
   149→        _absolutize_review_path(file_path, project_root=resolved_project_root)
   150→        for file_path in reviewed_files_rel
   151→    }
   152→    review_potential_files = valid_reviewed_files | {
   153→        *reviewed_files_rel,
   154→        *reviewed_files_abs,
   155→    }
   156→
   157→    potentials = _lang_potentials(state, lang_name)
   158→    potentials["review"] = len(review_potential_files)
   159→
   160→    diff = merge_scan(
   161→        state,
   162→        review_findings,
   163→        options=MergeScanOptions(
   164→            lang=lang_name,
   165→            potentials={"review": potentials.get("review", 0)},
   166→            merge_potentials=True,
   167→        ),
   168→    )
   169→
   170→    new_ids = {finding["id"] for finding in review_findings}
   171→    reimported_files = valid_reviewed_files
   172→    auto_resolve_review_findings(
   173→        state,
   174→        new_ids=new_ids,
   175→        diff=diff,
   176→        note="not reported in latest per-file re-import",
   177→        should_resolve=lambda finding: (
   178→            finding.get("detector") == "review"
   179→            and not finding.get("detail", {}).get("holistic")
   180→            and finding.get("file", "") in reimported_files
   181→        ),
   182→        utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   183→    )
   184→
   185→    if skipped:
   186→        diff["skipped"] = len(skipped)
   187→        diff["skipped_details"] = skipped
   188→
   189→    update_review_cache(
   190→        state,
   191→        findings_list,
   192→        reviewed_files=reviewed_files,
   193→        project_root=resolved_project_root,
   194→        utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   195→    )
   196→    return diff
   197→
   198→
   199→def update_review_cache(
   200→    state: dict[str, Any],
   201→    findings_data: list[ReviewFindingPayload],
   202→    *,
   203→    reviewed_files: list[str] | None = None,
   204→    project_root: Path | str | None = None,
   205→    utc_now_fn=utc_now,
   206→) -> None:
   207→    """Update per-file review cache with timestamps and content hashes."""
   208→    findings_by_file: dict[str, int] = {}
   209→    for finding in findings_data:
   210→        file_path = finding.get("file")
   211→        if not isinstance(file_path, str):
   212→            continue
   213→        findings_by_file[file_path] = findings_by_file.get(file_path, 0) + 1
   214→
   215→    refresh_review_file_cache(
   216→        state,
   217→        reviewed_files=reviewed_files,
   218→        findings_by_file=findings_by_file,
   219→        project_root=project_root,
   220→        hash_file_fn=hash_file,
   221→        utc_now_fn=utc_now_fn,
   222→    )
   223→

   231→    dimension_notes = _normalize_optional_mapping_field(
   232→        payload,
   233→        key="dimension_notes",
   234→        errors=errors,
   235→    )
   236→    policy = payload.get(_ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY)
   237→    normalized_policy = (
   238→        policy if isinstance(policy, dict) else AssessmentImportPolicyModel().to_dict()
   239→    )
   240→    if errors:
   241→        return None, errors
   242→    return (
   243→        {
   244→            "findings": findings,
   245→            "assessments": assessments,
   246→            "reviewed_files": normalized_reviewed_files,
   247→            "review_scope": review_scope,
   248→            "provenance": provenance,
   249→            "dimension_notes": dimension_notes,
   250→            [REDACTED],
   251→        },
   252→        [],
   253→    )

   255→
   256→def _default_blind_packet_path() -> Path:
   257→    return get_project_root() / ".desloppify" / "review_packet_blind.json"
   258→
   259→
   260→def _is_sha256_hex(raw: object) -> bool:
   261→    return (
   262→        isinstance(raw, str)
   263→        and len(raw) == 64
   264→        and all(ch in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for ch in raw)
   265→    )
   266→
   267→
   268→def _hash_file_sha256(path: Path) -> str | None:
   269→    try:
   270→        data = path.read_bytes()
   271→    except OSError:
   272→        return None
   273→    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
   274→
   275→
   276→def _resolve_packet_path(raw_path: object) -> Path | None:
   277→    if not isinstance(raw_path, str):
   278→        return None
   279→    text = raw_path.strip()
   280→    if not text:
   281→        return None
   282→    path = Path(text)
   283→    return path if path.is_absolute() else get_project_root() / path
   284→
   285→
   286→def _assessment_provenance_status(
   287→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   288→    *,
   289→    import_file: str,
   290→) -> AssessmentProvenanceModel:
   291→    """Evaluate whether assessments come from a trusted blind batch artifact."""
   292→    provenance = findings_data["provenance"]
   293→    if not provenance:
   294→        return AssessmentProvenanceModel(
   295→            trusted=False,
   296→            reason="missing provenance metadata",
   297→            import_file=import_file,
   298→        )
   299→
   300→    kind = str(provenance.get("kind", "")).strip()

   503→def _attach_assessment_policy(
   504→    payload: ReviewImportPayload,
   505→    *,
   506→    policy: AssessmentImportPolicyModel,
   507→) -> ReviewImportPayload:
   508→    normalized = dict(payload)
   509→    normalized[_ASSESSMENT_POLICY_KEY] = policy.to_dict()
   510→    return normalized
   511→
   512→
   513→def _build_findings_only_policy_reason(
   514→    *,
   515→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   516→    provenance_status: AssessmentProvenanceModel,
   517→) -> str:
   518→    if not findings_data["provenance"]:
   519→        return "missing trusted run-batches source; imported findings only"
   520→
   521→    provenance_reason = provenance_status.reason.strip()
   522→    if provenance_status.trusted is True:
   523→        return (
   524→            "external imports cannot self-attest trust even when provenance appears valid; "
   525→            "run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   526→        )
   527→    if provenance_reason:
   528→        return (
   529→            "external imports cannot self-attest trust "
   530→            f"({provenance_reason}); run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   531→        )
   532→    return (
   533→        "external imports cannot self-attest trust; "
   534→        "run review --run-batches to apply assessments automatically"
   535→    )
   536→
   537→
   538→def _attested_external_policy_update(
   539→    *,
   540→    policy: AssessmentImportPolicyModel,
   541→    provenance_status: AssessmentProvenanceModel,
   542→    attested_attest: str | None,
   543→) -> tuple[AssessmentImportPolicyModel | None, list[str]]:
   544→    normalized_attest = _validate_attested_external_attestation(attested_attest)
   545→    if normalized_attest is None:
   546→        return None, [
   547→            "--attested-external requires --attest containing both "
   548→            "'without awareness' and 'unbiased'"
   549→        ]
   550→    if provenance_status.trusted is not True:
   551→        return None, [
   552→            "--attested-external requires valid blind packet provenance "
   553→            f"(current status: {provenance_status.reason or 'untrusted provenance'})"
   554→        ]
   555→    runner = provenance_status.runner.strip().lower()
   556→    if runner not in _ATTESTED_EXTERNAL_RUNNERS:
   557→        return None, [
   558→            "--attested-external currently supports runner='claude' provenance only"
   559→        ]
   560→    return (
   561→        replace(
   562→            policy,
   563→            mode="attested_external",
   564→            trusted=True,
   565→            reason="attested external blind subagent provenance",
   566→            attest=normalized_attest,
   567→        ),
   568→        [],
   569→    )
   570→
   571→
   572→def _manual_override_policy_update(
   573→    *,
   574→    policy: AssessmentImportPolicyModel,
   575→    manual_attest: str | None,
   576→) -> tuple[AssessmentImportPolicyModel | None, list[str]]:
   577→    normalized_attest = _validate_manual_override_attestation(manual_attest)
   578→    if normalized_attest is None:
   579→        return None, [
   580→            "--manual-override requires --attest containing all "
   581→            "'I promise', 'not gaming the score', and 'legitimate change'"
   582→        ]
   583→    return (
   584→        replace(
   585→            policy,
   586→            mode="manual_override",
   587→            reason="manual override attested by operator",
   588→            attest=normalized_attest,
   589→        ),
   590→        [],
   591→    )
   592→
   593→

   595→    findings_data: ReviewImportPayload,
   596→    *,
   597→    import_file: str,
   598→    attested_external: bool,
   599→    attested_attest: str | None,

   100→def _relative_to_base(filepath: str, *, resolved_base: Path) -> str | None:
   101→    """Return ``filepath`` relative to ``resolved_base`` when inside the base tree."""
   102→    try:
   103→        resolved = Path(filepath).resolve()
   104→        return resolved.relative_to(resolved_base).as_posix()
   105→    except ValueError:

   109→def _collect_allowed_review_files(
   110→    files: list[str],
   111→    lang: object,
   112→    *,
   113→    base_path: Path | None = None,
   114→) -> set[str]:
   115→    """Return relative production-file paths allowed for holistic review batches."""
   116→    allowed: set[str] = set()
   117→    zone_map = getattr(lang, "zone_map", None)
   118→    resolved_base = base_path.resolve() if isinstance(base_path, Path) else None
   119→    for filepath in files:
   120→        if not isinstance(filepath, str):
   121→            continue
   122→        normalized = filepath.strip().replace("\\", "/")
   123→        if not normalized:
   124→            continue
   125→        if zone_map is not None:
   126→            try:
   127→                zone = zone_map.get(filepath)
   128→                zone_value = getattr(zone, "value", str(zone))
   129→            except (AttributeError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
   130→                zone_value = "production"
   131→            if zone_value in _NON_PRODUCTION_ZONES:
   132→                continue
   133→        allowed.add(normalized)
   134→        allowed.add(rel(filepath))
   135→        if resolved_base is not None:
   136→            relative = _relative_to_base(filepath, resolved_base=resolved_base)
   137→            if relative is not None:
   138→                allowed.add(relative)
   139→    return allowed

   142→def _file_in_allowed_scope(filepath: object, allowed_files: set[str]) -> bool:
   143→    """True when *filepath* resolves to a currently in-scope review file."""
   144→    if not isinstance(filepath, str):
   145→        return False
   146→    normalized = filepath.strip().replace("\\", "/")
   147→    if not normalized:
   148→        return False
   149→    if normalized in allowed_files:
   150→        return True
   151→    return rel(filepath) in allowed_files

   154→def _filter_issue_focus_to_scope(
   155→    issue_focus: object,
   156→    allowed_files: set[str],
   157→) -> dict[str, object] | None:
   158→    """Drop out-of-scope related_files from historical issue focus payload."""
   159→    if not isinstance(issue_focus, dict):
   160→        return None
   161→    issues_raw = issue_focus.get("issues", [])
   162→    issues: list[dict[str, object]] = []
   163→    if isinstance(issues_raw, list):
   164→        for raw_issue in issues_raw:
   165→            if not isinstance(raw_issue, dict):
   166→                continue
   167→            issue = dict(raw_issue)
   168→            related_raw = issue.get("related_files", [])
   169→            if isinstance(related_raw, list):
   170→                issue["related_files"] = [
   171→                    path
   172→                    for path in related_raw
   173→                    if _file_in_allowed_scope(path, allowed_files)
   174→                ]
   175→            issues.append(issue)
   176→    scoped = dict(issue_focus)
   177→    scoped["issues"] = issues
   178→    scoped["selected_count"] = len(issues)
   179→    return scoped

   205→
   206→        concern_signals = batch.get("concern_signals", [])
   207→        if isinstance(concern_signals, list):

   213→            ]
   214→            if "concern_signal_count" in batch:
   215→                batch["concern_signal_count"] = len(batch["concern_signals"])
   216→
   217→        issue_focus = _filter_issue_focus_to_scope(

   226→        if has_seed_files or has_signals:

   231→def prepare_review(
   232→    path: Path,
   233→    lang: object,
   234→    state: dict,
   235→    options: ReviewPrepareOptions | None = None,
   236→) -> dict[str, object]:
   237→    """Prepare review data for agent consumption. Returns structured dict.
   238→
   239→    If *files* is provided, skip file_finder (avoids redundant filesystem walks
   240→    when the caller already has the file list, e.g. from _setup_lang).
   241→    """
   242→    resolved_options = options or ReviewPrepareOptions()
   243→    resolved_options.max_files = _normalize_max_files(resolved_options.max_files)
   244→    all_files = (
   245→        resolved_options.files
   246→        if resolved_options.files is not None
   247→        else (lang.file_finder(path) if lang.file_finder else [])
   248→    )
   249→
   250→    # Enable file cache for entire prepare operation — context building,
   251→    # file selection, and content extraction all read the same files.
   252→    already_cached = is_file_cache_enabled()
   253→    if not already_cached:
   254→        enable_file_cache()
   255→    try:
   256→        context = build_review_context(path, lang, state, files=all_files)
   257→        selected = select_files_for_review(
   258→            lang,
   259→            path,
   260→            state,
   261→            options=ReviewSelectionOptions(
   262→                max_files=resolved_options.max_files,
   263→                max_age_days=resolved_options.max_age_days,
   264→                force_refresh=resolved_options.force_refresh,
   265→                files=all_files,
   266→            ),
   267→        )
   268→        file_requests = _build_file_requests(selected, lang, state)
   269→    finally:
   270→        if not already_cached:
   271→            disable_file_cache()
   272→
   273→    default_dims, dimension_prompts, system_prompt = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang.name)
   274→    dims = resolve_dimensions(
   275→        cli_dimensions=resolved_options.dimensions,
   276→        config_dimensions=resolved_options.config_dimensions,
   277→        default_dimensions=default_dims,
   278→    )
   279→    lang_guide = get_lang_guidance(lang.name)
   280→    valid_dims = set(dimension_prompts)
   281→    invalid_requested = [
   282→        dim for dim in (resolved_options.dimensions or []) if dim not in valid_dims
   283→    ]
   284→    invalid_config = [
   285→        dim
   286→        for dim in (resolved_options.config_dimensions or [])
   287→        if dim not in valid_dims
   288→    ]
   289→
   290→    return {
   291→        "command": "review",
   292→        "language": lang.name,
   293→        "dimensions": dims,
   294→        "dimension_prompts": {
   295→            d: dimension_prompts[d] for d in dims if d in dimension_prompts
   296→        },
   297→        "lang_guidance": lang_guide,
   298→        "context": serialize_context(context),
   299→        "system_prompt": system_prompt,
   300→        "files": file_requests,
   301→        "total_candidates": len(file_requests),
   302→        "cache_status": {
   303→            "fresh": count_fresh(state, resolved_options.max_age_days),
   304→            "stale": count_stale(state, resolved_options.max_age_days),
   305→            "new": len(file_requests),
   306→        },
   307→        "invalid_dimensions": {
   308→            "requested": invalid_requested,
   309→            "config": invalid_config,
   310→        },
   311→    }

   314→def _build_file_requests(files: list[str], lang, state: dict) -> list[dict]:
   315→    """Build per-file review request dicts."""
   316→    file_requests = []
   317→    for filepath in files:
   318→        content = read_file_text(abs_path(filepath))
   319→        if content is None:
   320→            continue
   321→
   322→        rpath = rel(filepath)
   323→        zone = "production"
   324→        if lang.zone_map is not None:
   325→            zone = lang.zone_map.get(filepath).value
   326→
   327→        neighbors: dict
   328→        if lang.dep_graph:
   329→            entry = dep_graph_lookup(lang.dep_graph, filepath)
   330→            imports_raw = entry.get("imports", set())
   331→            importers_raw = entry.get("importers", set())
   332→            importer_count_value = importer_count(entry)
   333→            neighbors = {
   334→                "imports": _rel_list(imports_raw),
   335→                "importers": _rel_list(importers_raw),
   336→                "importer_count": importer_count_value,
   337→            }
   338→        else:
   339→            neighbors = {}
   340→
   341→        file_requests.append(
   342→            {
   343→                "file": rpath,
   344→                "content": content,
   345→                "zone": zone,
   346→                "loc": len(content.splitlines()),
   347→                "neighbors": neighbors,
   348→                "existing_findings": get_file_findings(state, filepath),
   349→            }
   350→        )
   351→    return file_requests

   410→            concern
   411→            for concern in concerns
   412→            if _file_in_allowed_scope(getattr(concern, "file", ""), allowed_review_files)
   413→        ]
   414→        concerns_batch = _batch_concerns(
   415→            concerns,
   416→            max_files=resolved_options.max_files_per_batch,
   417→            active_dimensions=dims,
   418→        )
   419→    except (ImportError, AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   420→        logger.debug("Concern generation failed (best-effort): %s", exc)
   421→        concerns_batch = None
   422→    if concerns_batch:
   423→        batches.append(concerns_batch)
   424→
   425→    batches = _filter_batches_to_dimensions(
   426→        batches,
   427→        dims,
   428→        fallback_max_files=resolved_options.max_files_per_batch,
   429→    )
   430→    include_full_sweep = bool(resolved_options.include_full_sweep)
   431→    # Explicitly scoped dimension runs should stay scoped by default.
   432→    if resolved_options.dimensions:
   433→        include_full_sweep = False
   434→    if include_full_sweep:
   435→        append_full_sweep_batch(
   436→            batches=batches,
   437→            dims=dims,
   438→            all_files=all_files,
   439→            lang=lang,
   440→            max_files=resolved_options.max_files_per_batch,
   441→        )
   442→    batches = _filter_batches_to_file_scope(
   443→        batches,
   444→        allowed_files=allowed_review_files,
   445→    )
   446→
   447→    # Holistic mode can receive per-file-oriented dimensions via CLI suggestions.
   448→    # Attach whichever prompt definition exists so reviewers always get guidance.
   449→    selected_prompts: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
   450→    for dim in dims:
   451→        prompt = holistic_prompts.get(dim)
   452→        if prompt is None:
   453→            prompt = per_file_prompts.get(dim)
   454→        if prompt is None:
   455→            continue
   456→        selected_prompts[dim] = prompt
   457→
   458→    payload = {
   459→        "command": "review",
   460→        "mode": "holistic",
   461→        "language": lang.name,
   462→        "dimensions": dims,
   463→        "dimension_prompts": selected_prompts,
   464→        "lang_guidance": lang_guide,
   465→        "holistic_context": context.to_dict(),
   466→        "review_context": serialize_context(review_ctx),
   467→        "system_prompt": system_prompt,
   468→        "total_files": context.codebase_stats.get("total_files", 0),
   469→        "workflow": HOLISTIC_WORKFLOW,
   470→        "invalid_dimensions": {
   471→            "requested": invalid_requested,
   472→            "default": invalid_default,
   473→        },
   474→    }
   475→    if resolved_options.include_issue_history:
   476→        history_payload = build_issue_history_context(
   477→            state,
   478→            options=ReviewHistoryOptions(
   479→                max_issues=resolved_options.issue_history_max_issues,
   480→            ),
   481→        )
   482→        payload["historical_review_issues"] = history_payload
   483→        for batch in batches:
   484→            if not isinstance(batch, dict):
   485→                continue
   486→            batch_dims = batch.get("dimensions", [])
   487→            batch["historical_issue_focus"] = build_batch_issue_focus(
   488→                history_payload,
   489→                dimensions=batch_dims,
   490→                max_items=resolved_options.issue_history_max_batch_items,
   491→            )
   492→        batches = _filter_batches_to_file_scope(
   493→            batches,
   494→            allowed_files=allowed_review_files,
   495→        )
   496→    payload["investigation_batches"] = batches
   497→    return payload
   498→

    26→def _normalize_file_path(value: object) -> str | None:
    27→    """Normalize/validate candidate file paths for batch payloads."""
    28→    if not isinstance(value, str):
    29→        return None
    30→    text = value.strip().strip(",'\"")
    31→    if not text or text in {".", ".."}:
    32→        return None
    33→    if text.endswith("/"):
    34→        return None
    35→
    36→    basename = Path(text).name
    37→    if not basename:
    38→        return None
    39→    if "." not in basename and basename.lower() not in _EXTENSIONLESS_FILENAMES:
    40→        return None
    41→    return text
    42→

    44→def _collect_unique_files(
    45→    sources: list[list[dict]],
    46→    key: str = "file",
    47→    *,
    48→    max_files: int | None = None,
    49→) -> list[str]:
    50→    """Collect unique file paths from multiple source lists."""
    51→    seen: set[str] = set()
    52→    out: list[str] = []
    53→    for src in sources:
    54→        for item in src:
    55→            f = _normalize_file_path(item.get(key, ""))
    56→            if f and f not in seen:
    57→                seen.add(f)
    58→                out.append(f)
    59→                if max_files is not None and len(out) >= max_files:
    60→                    return out
    61→    return out
    62→
    63→
    64→def _existing_repo_files(
    65→    repo_root: Path | None,
    66→    candidates: tuple[str, ...],
    67→) -> list[str]:
    68→    """Return repository-relative paths for candidate files that exist."""
    69→    if repo_root is None:
    70→        return []
    71→    out: list[str] = []
    72→    for candidate in candidates:
    73→        if (repo_root / candidate).is_file():
    74→            out.append(candidate)
    75→    return out
    76→
    77→
    78→def _collect_files_from_batches(
    79→    batches: list[dict], *, max_files: int | None = None
    80→) -> list[str]:
    81→    """Collect unique file paths across batch payloads (preserving order)."""
    82→    seen: set[str] = set()
    83→    out: list[str] = []
    84→    for batch in batches:
    85→        for filepath in batch.get("files_to_read", []):
    86→            normalized = _normalize_file_path(filepath)
    87→            if not normalized:
    88→                continue
    89→            if normalized in seen:
    90→                continue
    91→            seen.add(normalized)
    92→            out.append(normalized)
    93→            if max_files is not None and len(out) >= max_files:
    94→                return out
    95→    return out

    98→def _representative_files_for_directory(
    99→    ctx: HolisticContext,
   100→    directory: str,
   101→    *,
   102→    max_files: int = 3,
   103→) -> list[str]:
   104→    """Map a directory-level signal to representative file paths."""
   105→    if not isinstance(directory, str) or not directory.strip():
   106→        return []
   107→
   108→    dir_key = directory.strip()
   109→    if dir_key in {".", "./"}:
   110→        normalized_dir = "."
   111→    else:
   112→        normalized_dir = f"{dir_key.rstrip('/')}/"
   113→
   114→    profiles = ctx.structure.get("directory_profiles", {})
   115→    profile = profiles.get(normalized_dir)
   116→    if not isinstance(profile, dict):
   117→        return []
   118→
   119→    out: list[str] = []
   120→    for filename in profile.get("files", []):
   121→        if not isinstance(filename, str) or not filename:
   122→            continue
   123→        filepath = (
   124→            filename
   125→            if normalized_dir == "."
   126→            else f"{normalized_dir.rstrip('/')}/{filename}"
   127→        )
   128→        normalized = _normalize_file_path(filepath)
   129→        if not normalized or normalized in out:
   130→            continue
   131→        out.append(normalized)
   132→        if len(out) >= max_files:
   133→            break
   134→    return out

   470→    if max_files is not None:
   471→        files = files[:max_files]
   472→    return {
   473→        "name": "Governance & Contracts",
   474→        "dimensions": [
   475→            "cross_module_architecture",
   476→            "high_level_elegance",
   477→            "test_strategy",
   478→            "package_organization",
   479→        ],
   480→        "files_to_read": files,
   481→        "why": "architecture contracts, compatibility policy, docs-vs-runtime scope, and quality-gate coverage",
   482→    }
   483→
   484→
   485→def _ensure_holistic_context(holistic_ctx: HolisticContext | dict) -> HolisticContext:
   486→    if isinstance(holistic_ctx, HolisticContext):
   487→        return holistic_ctx
   488→    return HolisticContext.from_raw(holistic_ctx)
   489→
   490→
   491→def build_investigation_batches(
   492→    holistic_ctx: HolisticContext | dict,
   493→    lang: object,
   494→    *,
   495→    repo_root: Path | None = None,
   496→    max_files_per_batch: int | None = None,
   497→) -> list[dict]:
   498→    """Derive parallelizable investigation batches from holistic context."""
   499→    ctx = _ensure_holistic_context(holistic_ctx)
   500→    del lang  # Reserved for future language-specific batch shaping.
   501→    batches = [
   502→        _batch_arch_coupling(ctx, max_files=max_files_per_batch),
   503→        _batch_conventions_errors(ctx, max_files=max_files_per_batch),
   504→        _batch_abstractions_deps(ctx, max_files=max_files_per_batch),
   505→        _batch_testing_api(ctx, max_files=max_files_per_batch),
   506→        _batch_authorization(ctx, max_files=max_files_per_batch),
   507→        _batch_ai_debt_migrations(ctx, max_files=max_files_per_batch),
   508→        _batch_package_organization(ctx, max_files=max_files_per_batch),
   509→        _batch_state_design(ctx, max_files=max_files_per_batch),
   510→        _batch_governance_contracts(
   511→            ctx,
   512→            repo_root=repo_root,
   513→            max_files=max_files_per_batch,
   514→        ),
   515→    ]
   516→    return [batch for batch in batches if batch["files_to_read"]]
   517→
   518→
   519→def filter_batches_to_dimensions(
   520→    batches: list[dict],
   521→    dimensions: list[str],
   522→    *,
   523→    fallback_max_files: int | None = 80,
   524→) -> list[dict]:
   525→    """Keep only dimensions explicitly active for this holistic review run.
   526→
   527→    If selected dimensions are not represented by any batch mapping, append a
   528→    fallback batch over representative files so scoped runs still get guidance.
   529→    """
   530→    selected = [d for d in dimensions if isinstance(d, str) and d]
   531→    if not selected:
   532→        return []
   533→    selected_set = set(selected)
   534→    filtered: list[dict] = []
   535→    covered: set[str] = set()
   536→    for batch in batches:
   537→        batch_dims = [dim for dim in batch.get("dimensions", []) if dim in selected_set]
   538→        if not batch_dims:
   539→            continue
   540→        filtered.append({**batch, "dimensions": batch_dims})
   541→        covered.update(batch_dims)
   542→
   543→    missing = [dim for dim in selected if dim not in covered]
   544→    if not missing:
   545→        return filtered
   546→
   547→    # Keep fallback batches tractable; giant sweeps are expensive and often
   548→    # unnecessary when dimensions are already explicitly scoped.
   549→    max_files = fallback_max_files if isinstance(fallback_max_files, int) else None
   550→    if isinstance(max_files, int) and max_files <= 0:
   551→        max_files = None
   552→    fallback_files = _collect_files_from_batches(filtered or batches, max_files=max_files)
   553→    if not fallback_files:
   554→        return filtered
   555→
   556→    filtered.append(
   557→        {
   558→            "name": "Cross-cutting Sweep",
   559→            "dimensions": missing,
   560→            "files_to_read": fallback_files,
   561→            "why": "selected dimensions had no direct batch mapping; review representative cross-cutting files",
   562→        }
   563→    )
   564→    return filtered
   565→
   566→
   567→def batch_concerns(
   568→    concerns: list,
   569→    *,
   570→    max_files: int | None = None,
   571→    active_dimensions: list[str] | None = None,
   572→) -> dict | None:
   573→    """Build investigation batch from mechanical concern signals.
   574→
   575→    *concerns* should be a list of Concern dataclass instances from
   576→    ``desloppify.engine.concerns``.
   577→    """
   578→    if not concerns:
   579→        return None
   580→    default_dims = ["design_coherence", "initialization_coupling"]
   581→    selected_dims = [
   582→        dim for dim in (active_dimensions or [])
   583→        if isinstance(dim, str) and dim
   584→    ]
   585→    selected_set = set(selected_dims)
   586→    overlap_dims = [dim for dim in default_dims if dim in selected_set]
   587→    concern_dims = overlap_dims or list(default_dims)
   588→    mapped_to_active_dims = bool(selected_dims) and not overlap_dims
   589→    if mapped_to_active_dims:
   590→        # Prevent concern signals from being silently dropped by scoped runs.
   591→        concern_dims = list(selected_dims)
   592→
   593→    types = sorted({c.type for c in concerns if c.type})
   594→    why_parts = ["mechanical detectors identified structural patterns needing judgment"]
   595→    if types:
   596→        why_parts.append(f"concern types: {', '.join(types)}")
   597→    if mapped_to_active_dims:
   598→        why_parts.append(
   599→            "mapped to active dimensions because design_coherence/initialization_coupling are not selected"
   600→        )
   601→    files: list[str] = []
   602→    seen: set[str] = set()
   603→    concern_signals: list[dict[str, object]] = []
   604→    for concern in concerns:
   605→        candidate = _normalize_file_path(getattr(concern, "file", ""))
   606→        if not candidate or candidate in seen:
   607→            continue
   608→        seen.add(candidate)
   609→        files.append(candidate)
   610→
   611→        evidence_raw = getattr(concern, "evidence", ())
   612→        evidence = [
   613→            str(entry).strip()
   614→            for entry in evidence_raw
   615→            if isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip()
   616→        ][:4]
   617→        summary = str(getattr(concern, "summary", "")).strip()
   618→        question = str(getattr(concern, "question", "")).strip()
   619→        concern_type = str(getattr(concern, "type", "")).strip()
   620→        concern_signals.append(
   621→            {
   622→                "type": concern_type or "design_concern",
   623→                "file": candidate,
   624→                "summary": summary or "Mechanical concern requires subjective judgment",
   625→                "question": question or "Is this pattern intentional or debt?",
   626→                "evidence": evidence,
   627→            }
   628→        )
   629→
   630→    total_candidate_files = len(files)
   631→    if (
   632→        max_files is not None
   633→        and isinstance(max_files, int)
   634→        and max_files > 0
   635→        and total_candidate_files > max_files
   636→    ):
   637→        files = files[:max_files]
   638→        why_parts.append(
   639→            f"truncated to {max_files} files from {total_candidate_files} candidates"
   640→        )
   641→
   642→    return {
   643→        "name": "Design coherence — Mechanical Concern Signals",
   644→        "dimensions": concern_dims,
   645→        "files_to_read": files,
   646→        "why": "; ".join(why_parts),
   647→        "total_candidate_files": total_candidate_files,
   648→        "concern_signals": concern_signals[:12],
   649→        "concern_signal_count": len(concern_signals),
   650→        "mapped_to_active_dimensions": mapped_to_active_dims,
   651→    }
   652→
   653→
   654→__all__ = ["batch_concerns", "build_investigation_batches", "filter_batches_to_dimensions"]
   655→

    34→# Mechanical detectors → subjective dimensions they provide evidence for.
    35→# When findings from these detectors change during a scan, the corresponding
    36→# subjective assessments are marked stale so reviewers know to re-evaluate.
    37→_DETECTOR_SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSIONS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    38→    "structural": ("design_coherence", "abstraction_fitness"),
    39→    "smells": ("design_coherence", "error_consistency"),
    40→    "global_mutable_config": ("initialization_coupling",),
    41→    "coupling": ("cross_module_architecture",),
    42→    "layer_violation": ("cross_module_architecture",),
    43→    "private_imports": ("cross_module_architecture",),
    44→    "dupes": ("convention_outlier",),
    45→    "boilerplate_duplication": ("convention_outlier",),
    46→    "naming": ("convention_outlier",),
    47→    "flat_dirs": ("package_organization",),
    48→    "orphaned": ("design_coherence",),
    49→    "uncalled_functions": ("design_coherence",),
    50→    "responsibility_cohesion": ("design_coherence", "abstraction_fitness"),
    51→    "cycles": ("cross_module_architecture", "dependency_health"),
    52→}
    53→
    54→
    55→def _mark_stale_on_mechanical_change(
    56→    state: StateModel,
    57→    *,
    58→    changed_detectors: set[str],
    59→    now: str,
    60→) -> None:
    61→    """Mark subjective assessments stale when mechanical findings change.
    62→
    63→    Only marks dimensions that already have an assessment — doesn't create
    64→    new entries for dimensions that have never been reviewed.
    65→    """
    66→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    67→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    68→        return
    69→
    70→    affected_dims: set[str] = set()
    71→    for detector in changed_detectors:
    72→        dims = _DETECTOR_SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSIONS.get(detector, ())
    73→        affected_dims.update(dims)
    74→
    75→    if not affected_dims:
    76→        return
    77→
    78→    for dimension in sorted(affected_dims):
    79→        if dimension not in assessments:
    80→            continue
    81→        payload = assessments[dimension]
    82→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    83→            continue
    84→        # Don't overwrite if already stale
    85→        if payload.get("needs_review_refresh"):
    86→            continue
    87→        payload["needs_review_refresh"] = True
    88→        payload["refresh_reason"] = "mechanical_findings_changed"
    89→        payload["stale_since"] = now
    90→

    93→class MergeScanOptions:
    94→    """Configuration bundle for merging a scan into persisted state."""
    95→
    96→    lang: str | None = None
    97→    scan_path: str | None = None
    98→    force_resolve: bool = False
    99→    exclude: tuple[str, ...] = ()
   100→    potentials: dict[str, int] | None = None
   101→    merge_potentials: bool = False
   102→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   103→    include_slow: bool = True
   104→    ignore: list[str] | None = None
   105→    subjective_integrity_target: float | None = None
   106→
   107→
   108→def merge_scan(
   109→    state: StateModel,
   110→    current_findings: list[dict],
   111→    options: MergeScanOptions | None = None,
   112→) -> ScanDiff:
   113→    """Merge a fresh scan into existing state and return a diff summary."""
   114→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   115→    resolved_options = options or MergeScanOptions()
   116→
   117→    now = utc_now()
   118→    _record_scan_metadata(
   119→        state,
   120→        now,
   121→        lang=resolved_options.lang,
   122→        include_slow=resolved_options.include_slow,
   123→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   124→    )
   125→    _merge_scan_inputs(
   126→        state,
   127→        lang=resolved_options.lang,
   128→        potentials=resolved_options.potentials,
   129→        merge_potentials=resolved_options.merge_potentials,
   130→        codebase_metrics=resolved_options.codebase_metrics,
   131→    )
   132→
   133→    existing = state["findings"]
   134→    ignore_patterns = (
   135→        resolved_options.ignore
   136→        if resolved_options.ignore is not None
   137→        else state.get("config", {}).get("ignore", [])
   138→    )
   139→    current_ids, new_count, reopened_count, current_by_detector, ignored_count, upsert_changed = (
   140→        upsert_findings(
   141→            existing,
   142→            current_findings,
   143→            ignore_patterns,
   144→            now,
   145→            lang=resolved_options.lang,
   146→        )
   147→    )
   148→
   149→    raw_findings = len(current_findings)
   150→    suppressed_pct = _compute_suppression(raw_findings, ignored_count)
   151→
   152→    ran_detectors = (
   153→        set(resolved_options.potentials.keys())
   154→        if resolved_options.potentials is not None
   155→        else None
   156→    )
   157→    suspect_detectors = find_suspect_detectors(
   158→        existing,
   159→        current_by_detector,
   160→        resolved_options.force_resolve,
   161→        ran_detectors,
   162→    )
   163→    auto_resolved, skipped_other_lang, skipped_out_of_scope, resolve_changed = auto_resolve_disappeared(
   164→        existing,
   165→        current_ids,
   166→        suspect_detectors,
   167→        now,
   168→        lang=resolved_options.lang,
   169→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   170→        exclude=resolved_options.exclude,
   171→    )
   172→
   173→    # Mark subjective assessments stale when mechanical findings changed.
   174→    changed_detectors = upsert_changed | resolve_changed
   175→    if changed_detectors:
   176→        _mark_stale_on_mechanical_change(
   177→            state, changed_detectors=changed_detectors, now=now,
   178→        )
   179→
   180→    _recompute_stats(

   183→        subjective_integrity_target=resolved_options.subjective_integrity_target,
   184→    )

   125→def _enrich_sections_from_evidence(
   126→    context: HolisticContext, evidence: dict

   128→    """Merge mechanical evidence into existing holistic context sections."""
   129→    if "complexity_hotspots" in evidence:

   131→    if "error_hotspots" in evidence:

   253→def _ignore_suppression_flag(state: StateModel) -> RiskFlag | None:
   254→    """Return risk flag when ignore suppression debt crosses thresholds."""
   255→    ignore_integrity = state.get("ignore_integrity", {})
   256→    suppressed_pct = float(ignore_integrity.get("suppressed_pct", 0.0) or 0.0)
   257→    ignored_count = int(ignore_integrity.get("ignored", 0) or 0)

   260→        and ignored_count < 100

   263→    severity = "high" if suppressed_pct >= 40.0 or ignored_count >= 200 else "medium"
   264→    message = (

   266→        if suppressed_pct > 0
   267→        else f"{ignored_count} findings hidden by ignore patterns"
   268→    )
   269→    return {
   270→        "type": "high_ignore_suppression",
   271→        "severity": severity,
   272→        "message": message,
   273→    }

   276→def _wontfix_gap_flag(debt: dict) -> RiskFlag | None:
   277→    """Return risk flag for strict/lenient wontfix gap debt."""
   278→    wontfix_count = int(debt.get("wontfix_count", 0) or 0)
   279→    overall_gap = float(debt.get("overall_gap", 0.0) or 0.0)
   280→    if overall_gap < _WONTFIX_GAP_THRESHOLD and wontfix_count <= 0:
   281→        return None
   282→    severity = "high" if overall_gap >= 5.0 or wontfix_count >= 50 else "medium"
   283→    return {
   284→        "type": "wontfix_gap",
   285→        "severity": severity,
   286→        "message": (
   287→            f"Strict/lenient gap is {overall_gap:.1f} pts with "

   298→def _compute_risk_flags(state: StateModel, debt: dict) -> list[RiskFlag]:

   300→    flags: list[RiskFlag] = []
   301→    for maybe_flag in (_ignore_suppression_flag(state), _wontfix_gap_flag(debt)):
   302→        if maybe_flag is not None:
   303→            flags.append(maybe_flag)

   335→def compute_narrative(
   336→    state: StateModel,
   337→    context: NarrativeContext | None = None,
   338→) -> NarrativeResult:
   339→    """Compute structured narrative context from state data."""
   340→    resolved_context = context or NarrativeContext()
   341→
   342→    diff = resolved_context.diff
   343→    lang = resolved_context.lang
   344→    command = resolved_context.command
   345→    config = resolved_context.config
   346→    plan = resolved_context.plan
   347→
   348→    raw_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
   349→    history = _history_for_lang(raw_history, lang)
   350→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})

   352→    strict_score, overall_score = _score_snapshot(state)

   356→    badge = _compute_badge_status()

   359→    dimensions = _analyze_dimensions(dim_scores, history, state)
   360→    debt = _analyze_debt(dim_scores, findings, history)
   361→    milestone = _detect_milestone(state, None, history)
   362→    plan_payload = dict(plan) if isinstance(plan, dict) else {}
   363→    plan_payload.setdefault("clusters", None)
   364→    clusters = plan_payload["clusters"]
   365→    action_context = ActionContext(

    47→def hash_file(filepath: str) -> str:

    56→def select_files_for_review(

   118→def _compute_review_priority(filepath: str, lang, state: dict) -> int:
   119→    """Higher = more important to review.
   120→
   121→    Prioritizes implementation files with high blast radius and existing findings.
   122→    Deprioritizes types/constants files (low subjective review value).

    62→def _annotate_plan_metadata(
    63→    *,
    64→    by_id: dict[str, dict],
    65→    overrides: dict,
    66→    clusters: dict,
    67→) -> None:
    68→    """Attach plan metadata fields to queue items."""
    69→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
    70→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
    71→        if override.get("description"):
    72→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
    73→        if override.get("note"):

    75→        if override.get("cluster"):
    76→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    77→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    78→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    79→                "name": cluster_name,
    80→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    81→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
    82→                "sibling_ids": cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []),
    83→            }
    84→
    85→
    86→def _ordered_ids_from_queue_order(
    87→    *,
    88→    queue_order: list[str],
    89→    by_id: dict[str, dict],
    90→    skipped_ids: set[str],
    91→) -> tuple[list[dict], set[str]]:
    92→    """Return items ordered by queue_order and their id set."""
    93→    ordered: list[dict] = []
    94→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
    95→    for finding_id in queue_order:
    96→        if finding_id in by_id and finding_id not in skipped_ids:
    97→            ordered.append(by_id[finding_id])
    98→            ordered_ids.add(finding_id)
    99→    return ordered, ordered_ids
   100→
   101→
   102→def _partition_plan_order_items(
   103→    *,
   104→    items: list[dict],
   105→    ordered_ids: set[str],
   106→    skipped_ids: set[str],
   107→) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict]]:
   108→    """Partition items into remaining and skipped after ordered ids are removed."""
   109→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
   110→    remaining: list[dict] = []
   111→    for item in items:
   112→        item_id = item["id"]
   113→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
   114→            continue
   115→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
   116→            skipped_items.append(item)
   117→        else:
   118→            remaining.append(item)
   119→    return remaining, skipped_items
   120→
   121→
   122→def _apply_queue_positions(
   123→    *,
   124→    result: list[dict],
   125→    skipped_ids: set[str],
   126→    skipped_map: dict,
   127→) -> None:
   128→    """Apply queue position and skip metadata to ordered result items."""
   129→    for position, item in enumerate(result):
   130→        item["queue_position"] = position + 1
   131→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   132→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   133→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   134→            if not skip_entry:
   135→                continue
   136→            item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   137→            skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   138→            if skip_reason:
   139→                item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   140→
   141→
   142→def _filter_to_active_cluster(
   143→    *,
   144→    result: list[dict],
   145→    clusters: dict,
   146→    cluster: str | None,
   147→    active_cluster: str | None,
   148→) -> list[dict]:
   149→    """Filter queue items to requested/active cluster members when provided."""
   150→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   151→    if not effective_cluster:
   152→        return result
   153→    cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   154→    cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   155→    if not cluster_member_ids:
   156→        return result
   157→    return [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   158→
   159→
   160→def _apply_plan_order(
   161→    items: list[dict],
   162→    plan: dict,
   163→    *,
   164→    include_skipped: bool = False,
   165→    cluster: str | None = None,
   166→) -> list[dict]:
   167→    """Reorder items according to the living plan.
   168→
   169→    1. Items in ``queue_order`` appear first, in that order.
   170→    2. Remaining items keep their mechanical sort.
   171→    3. Skipped items are appended last (or excluded).
   172→    4. Each item is annotated with plan metadata.
   173→    """
   174→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   175→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
   176→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
   177→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
   178→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
   179→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
   180→
   181→    by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in items}
   182→    _annotate_plan_metadata(by_id=by_id, overrides=overrides, clusters=clusters)
   183→    ordered, ordered_ids = _ordered_ids_from_queue_order(
   184→        queue_order=queue_order,
   185→        by_id=by_id,
   186→        skipped_ids=skipped_ids,
   187→    )
   188→    remaining, skipped_items = _partition_plan_order_items(
   189→        items=items,
   190→        ordered_ids=ordered_ids,
   191→        skipped_ids=skipped_ids,
   192→    )
   193→    result = ordered + remaining
   194→    if include_skipped:
   195→        result = result + skipped_items
   196→    _apply_queue_positions(
   197→        result=result,
   198→        skipped_ids=skipped_ids,
   199→        skipped_map=skipped_map,
   200→    )
